stem:
Farhan places a small brass screw and a large empty cardboard box on a balance. The brass screw is heavier than the cardboard box. The cardboard box looks larger.

What can he correctly conclude about mass?

options.text: The brass screw has more mass than the cardboard box.
The brass screw has more volume than the cardboard box.
The brass screw has less mass than the cardboard box.
The cardboard box has more mass than the brass screw because it is larger.

teacher.key_rationale: The heavier object has more mass. Volume and larger size are not the same as mass.
